Company Description

Are you ready to take ownership of business-critical WMS solutions supporting JYSK's highly automated Distribution Centers across Europe?

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

At JYSK, employees are the key to success. Growing from one store in 1979 to more than 3,600 stores worldwide today, JYSK is a true retail success story – and Logistics play a crucial role in enabling our growth, both in stores and online.

The three fundamental JYSK Values – Tradesman, Colleague and Corporate Spirit – express the behavior and attitude you can expect from your new colleagues.

At JYSK, colleagues trust each other, and believe in delegation and freedom with responsibility. You are expected to speak up and have a say in your working environment.

Job Description

WHAT YOUR NEW JOB WILL BE ABOUT

As Product Owner for our WMS solutions, you are responsible for setting direction, driving priorities and ensuring that business-critical solutions continue to support JYSK's highly automated Distribution Centers across Europe. Working closely with Logistics, IT and external partners, you balance operational stability with continuous improvements that create real business value.

In this role, you ensure that our WMS platform continues to meet business needs while remaining stable and reliable in daily operations. You identify improvement opportunities, prioritize development efforts and help ensure that new functionality is implemented successfully and delivers value to our logistics setup.

Your main responsibilities will be to:

• 
Secure the stability and continuous development of our WMS solutions

• 
Own and prioritize the Team Backlog to maximize business value and impact

• 
Act as the connecting link between Distribution Centers, Logistics, IT and external partners

• 
Provide people leadership and development for a Business Solution Specialist in the Scrum team

• 
Enable high-quality delivery by making timely decisions and setting clear direction

• 
Drive refinement and alignment to ensure shared understanding across teams

Your primary base will be at our Distribution Center in Uldum. As the role is international, 20–40 travel days per year are expected.

Qualifications

WHAT YOU NEED TO BRING

We are looking for a person with experience from logistics IT solutions in highly automated warehouse environments, combined with a strong understanding of how business processes and IT systems work together.

In addition, you will be described by the below mentioned characteristics:

• 
Experience working with Warehouse Management Systems, either as Product Owner, Application Specialist, Consultant, Project Manager or similar

• 
Strong stakeholder management skills

• 
It will be considered an advantage if you have experience working with SSI Schaefer solutions such as WAMAS or ANT.

• 
Strong understanding of Warehouse Management Systems and logistics processes in automated warehouse environments

• 
Balance value, cost, risk and effort when making prioritization decisions

• 
Communicate in a structured and transparent way

• 
Great English skills

Additional Information

IS THIS YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY? Apply today!

Recruitment process:

We process applications on an ongoing basis and complete recruitment when we find the right candidate.

If you have any questions, please contact IT Delivery Lead Pia Kristensen +45 40 90 50 71

ABOUT US

JYSK wants to include everyone, no matter the age, gender identity, race, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, ethnicity, and experience. Together, we secure our inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. Because a great mix of minds, talents and unique personalities makes us a stronger team.

For more information, please visit our career page

If you’d like to know more about how we process your personal data and your rights, please check our Privacy Policy.

**Build software at scale. Influence how we build it. Help shape the next generation of development at Dalux.

**Dalux is growing, and we are looking for experienced software developers who want significant technical ownership while continuing to build software hands-on.

You will work on products used by professionals around the world, contribute to architectural and technical decisions, and help us improve how we develop software – including how we use agentic AI to make capable developers more effective.

**Your role

**As an Experienced Software Developer, you will take ownership of complex product and technical problems from idea to production.

You will work in a product team with other developers, a Product Manager, and a Product Designer. We expect experienced developers to contribute beyond their individual tasks by making good technical decisions, improving our architecture and development practices, and sharing knowledge with others.

Your work can include:

• Owning complex features and technical problems end-to-end

• Designing scalable, maintainable solutions and contributing to architectural decisions

• Improving our codebase, tooling, developer workflows, and technical quality

• Driving or contributing to initiatives around DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure, architecture, or developer tooling

• Sparring with and mentoring other developers

• Working closely with Product Management and Design to understand problems and find the right solutions

• Bringing new ideas and technologies into Dalux when they can improve our products or how we build them

We expect experienced developers to have opinions, challenge existing solutions, and be comfortable having their own ideas challenged in return.

**Developing software with agentic AI

**We are significantly increasing our use of agentic AI in software development.

We use and explore AI across the development lifecycle – from understanding problems and navigating codebases to implementation, testing, debugging, refactoring, and review.

We are looking for developers who already use agentic AI as part of their development workflow. The specific tools matter less than how you use them: providing the right context and direction, critically evaluating the output, and knowing when to intervene or take a different approach.

Strong engineering fundamentals remain essential. AI can increase what a capable developer can achieve, but you remain responsible for the architecture, correctness, maintainability, and quality of the software you build.

At Dalux, you will help us take these ways of working further by experimenting, sharing what works, and helping establish effective practices for agentic software development.

**Technologies we work with

**Our platform is built on a distributed cloud architecture using AWS. Our primary technologies include:

• C# / .NET

• Angular / TypeScript

• GitHub Copilot

• MSSQL

• Elasticsearch

• AWS

• Optionally, Android / iOS development using .NET MAUI

You may also encounter parts of our C++ codebase.

Experience with our exact technology stack is useful, but strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to understand and improve complex systems matter more.

**Product development at Dalux

**Our developers do more than implement specifications.

Developers, Product Managers, and Product Designers work together to understand problems and find solutions that balance user value, usability, technical feasibility, business viability, and long-term technical health.

Our products are relied upon by professionals worldwide, making performance, stability, maintainability, and quality important parts of everyday engineering.

**Your background

**We expect that you:

• Have solid professional software development experience

• Have at least six months of practical experience using agentic AI as part of your software development workflow

• Hold a university degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, or a related technical field

• Have strong software engineering fundamentals

• Are comfortable owning complex technical problems and decisions

• Can navigate and improve an established codebase and architecture

• Care about maintainability, reliability, performance, and quality

• Enjoy technical sparring and sharing knowledge with other developers

• Understand the trade-offs between short-term delivery and long-term technical quality

Experience with C#/.NET, Angular, or cloud development is useful, but we do not expect you to match every technology we use.

**What You Can Expect From Dalux

**Dalux is a software company at heart. As an experienced developer, you can expect:

• Significant ownership and real influence on technical solutions

• Skilled colleagues who enjoy technical discussion and constructive challenge

• Close collaboration between Engineering, Product Management, and Design

• Short paths from ideas to decisions and implementation

• Opportunities to improve engineering practices beyond your immediate product work

• An environment actively investing in agentic AI for software development

• High levels of trust and freedom in how you solve problems

All Dalux software development takes place in-house at our headquarters in Vibenshuset, Copenhagen. Working together in person is an important part of how we collaborate, share knowledge, and make decisions quickly.

**About Dalux

**Dalux is a Danish software company founded in 2005 by Bent Dalgaard and Torben Dalgaard.

We build digital tools that make the construction industry smarter and more efficient. Using our own 3D BIM technology, we develop software used in more than 140 countries worldwide.

Our core technology is developed entirely in-house, giving our developers the opportunity to influence both the products and the technology behind them.

**Interested?

**If you want significant technical ownership while helping shape how modern software is developed at Dalux, we would like to hear from you.

**If agentic AI is already part of how you develop software, tell us how you use it – what you delegate, how you validate the result, and where you have found it genuinely useful.

**We recruit continuously and hire multiple experienced developers throughout the year as Dalux grows.

If you have questions about the position, contact IT Talent Acquisition Specialist Sara Nielsen on SNI@dalux.com

Commercial Excellence Analyst

PPG is a global coatings company with operations in over 70 countries and more than 180 years of industry leadership. As part of its Architectural Coatings EMEA division, PPG is executing a significant commercial transformation across all markets, and the Danish market is a key part of that journey.

This role is central to making that transformation happen on the ground while contributing to a regional agenda that reaches well beyond Denmark. • Act as the bridge between global strategy and local execution, ensuring that regional priorities are adapted and embedded effectively within the local organization.

• Experience working with Salesforce CRM is an advantage.

• Experience with Power BI or other business intelligence tools is a plus.

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail.

• A proactive mindset and eagerness to work across functions in an international environment.

Why Join PPG?

This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially minded analyst who wants to combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You will work closely with local leadership while gaining exposure to regional commercial excellence initiatives and best practices across EMEA.

How We Work

At PPG, we bring teams together to accelerate collaboration and career development, with in-person work Monday through Thursday and the opportunity to work remotely on Flexible Fridays. Schedules may vary by location.

Ready to make an impact? Join PPG and help shape the future of commercial excellence while building a rewarding international career.

jobs.occupation: Senior AI Engineer for The Tech Collective
jobs.description:
We're looking for a senior AI engineer with hands-on experience in generative AI, API integrations, and advanced agent-based applications. The ideal candidate brings a mix of full-stack, AI, and cloud engineering experience.

**What You'll Do

**This role cuts across multiple tech stacks and is a central part of how we deliver AI solutions for our clients.

**In This Role, You'll

**

• Translating early ideas into working prototypes and iterating them into production-ready solutions using modern full-stack frameworks

• Designing and deploying generative AI applications and autonomous agents using LLM APIs and established agent frameworks

• Integrating AI capabilities into client systems and managing deployment pipelines in cloud environments

• Collaborating with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to build solutions that address real needs

• Mentoring junior engineers and keeping pace with emerging AI and software engineering paradigms

**What You'll Bring

**We're looking for someone with at least five years of software development experience, including at least two in generative AI and agent-based applications, and a master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field.

**Beyond That, You'll Bring

**

• Full-stack capability across TypeScript (React, Next.js, Vite) and Python, with experience shipping production systems

• Hands-on experience with agent frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph, CrewAI, Agno, or DSPy

• Proficiency with RESTful APIs, cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP), and containerisation tools such as Docker and Kubernetes

• Strong communication skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders

Relevant AI or cloud certifications are a plus. English is our corporate language; however, proficiency in one or more additional languages is a plus for this role.

**What We Offer

**You'll join a fast-growing team backed by Implement Consulting Group — nerdy by nature, genuinely curious about both technology and people, and serious about craft. You'll have real autonomy, a strong culture of learning, and meaningful AI challenges across industries.

Ready to shape the digital future with us? We review applications on an ongoing basis and will close the role once filled, so apply ASAP.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Through co-creation and passionate advisory, we aim to make our clients’ data easy to handle and provide useful insights.

In our collective, you will find people with a combination of nerdiness and infectious energy. We are passionate about technology, but we also have a sincere interest in people.

jobs.occupation: Physiological & Sports Medicine Advisor - Elite Football
jobs.description:
At Twinspire, we're building a digital twin platform for individualised athlete modelling in elite football. We are already testing this live in clubs through ongoing pilot studies.

The question we care about is simple: can data-driven signals actually support decisions that practitioners trust?

The role

We're looking for a physiotherapist, sports medicine professional, or physician with experience in elite or semi-elite football. Not to validate what we're building, but to challenge it.

This is not a narrow return-to-play role. We're looking for someone who can connect:

• physiology

• data

• research

• and real-world decision-making

You understand that athlete management is not clean or protocol-driven, but contextual, uncertain, and often subjective. That's exactly the gap we're trying to close.

What you will do

You will work directly with the founding team and DTU research group.

You will:

• Pressure-test whether model outputs make sense physiologically

• Call out when signals don't translate to real decisions

• Help bridge the gap between research and applied practice

• Shape what a useful signal actually looks like in elite environments

• Push us to build something that holds up under scrutiny, not just in theory

What we are looking for

Someone who:

• Has worked closely with elite or semi-elite football players

• Brings strong physiological and/or sports medicine expertise

• Is comfortable questioning both data and established practice

• Has felt the gap between what's measured and what's actually useful

• Wants to be part of defining what better looks like

What we offer

• Direct involvement in a validation study with elite football clubs across the Nordics

• Opportunity for research co-authorship

• Equity participation

• A chance to shape how athlete modelling is applied in real environments

If this resonates, reach out: roxane@twinspire.ai

Join Caljan and Help Shape the Future of Automated Logistics Solutions

At Caljan, we develop innovative automation solutions that improve efficiency, safety, and productivity for customers around the world. We are now looking for a Lead Mechanical R&D Engineer to play a key role in the continued development of our Robotic and Automated Products (RAP) portfolio.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced mechanical engineer who enjoys combining technical leadership, product ownership, innovation, and hands-on engineering in an international environment. You will have a significant impact on the development strategy, performance, and future direction of our RAP product range while working closely with colleagues across functions and locations globally.

Your Responsibilities

As our Lead Mechanical R&D Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring the ongoing development, performance, quality, and competitiveness of the assigned product portfolio. You will serve as a senior technical authority within the mechanical engineering team and support product strategy, innovation, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Your key responsibilities will include:

**Product Leadership & Portfolio Development

**

• Drive the mechanical design direction of the RAP product range.

• Participate in Product Committee activities and ensure execution of agreed actions.

• Support strategic product development initiatives.

• Collaborate with Sales, Service, and Sales Support on technical requests and product-related inquiries.

• Continuously optimize product costs while maintaining quality standards.

• Contribute to customer claim handling and product improvement activities.

• Provide technical mentoring and guidance to fellow engineers.

**Mechanical Engineering & R&D

**

• Lead complex mechanical design activities from concept through release.

• Design mechanical systems, conveyor solutions, and automated equipment layouts.

• Conduct simulations, testing, and R&D activities to validate new concepts and technologies.

• Develop prototypes and evaluate emerging technologies together with global R&D teams.

• Participate in risk assessments, FMEA sessions, and compliance activities.

• Support installation and troubleshooting activities when required.

**Engineering Execution

**

• Create CAD models and technical drawings using Autodesk Inventor.

• Develop production documentation, bills of materials, and engineering specifications.

• Perform analytical calculations and engineering evaluations.

• Execute prototype testing, analyse results, and recommend improvements.

• Collaborate with suppliers and external partners on technical matters.

• Support standardization, modularization, and ongoing development of engineering systems and product configurators.

What We're Looking For

You are an experienced mechanical engineer who thrives on solving complex technical challenges while balancing commercial, quality, and product requirements. You enjoy working collaboratively and can confidently take technical ownership of projects and product development initiatives.

**Qualifications

**

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related technical discipline.

• Minimum 4-6 years of experience in Mechanical Engineering and R&D with experience leading mechanical design activities.

• Experience working in an international environment.

• Strong knowledge of Autodesk Inventor, SolidWorks, or similar CAD platforms.

• Experience with technical documentation, product development, and engineering calculations.

• Experience with cost analysis and optimization.

• Ability to work independently and provide technical leadership to others.

• Fluent in written and spoken English

**It Is an Advantage If You Also Have

**

• Experience with throughput simulations, machine design, structural calculations, and dynamics.

• Experience with PDM/PLM systems.

• Knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics AX.

• Experience participating in customer meetings, design reviews, and site visits.

**Personal Competencies

**We are looking for someone who:

• Raises the bar for engineering standards and quality.

• Is innovative and continuously seeks better solutions.

• Has strong technical problem-solving skills.

• Is structured, organized, and results-oriented.

• Is customer-focused and commercially aware.

• Communicates effectively and collaborates well across teams.

• Leads by example and enjoys sharing knowledge with colleagues.

What We Offer

At Caljan, you will become part of an ambitious and collaborative engineering environment where innovation and continuous improvement are at the center of everything we do. You will have the opportunity to influence future products, work with colleagues around the globe, and contribute to technologies that make a difference for customers worldwide.

The role is based in Denmark and includes travel activities of up to approximately 60 days per year.

Apply today and help shape the future of automated logistics solutions at Caljan.

jobs.occupation: Head of Strategy Execution and Projects
jobs.description:
Join us in this role where you'll lead our Strategy Execution and Projects team and help strengthen the enterprise-wide deployment of Ørsted's highest strategic priorities. You'll combine strategic leadership with hands-on execution, partnering closely with senior leaders to translate strategic ambitions into actionable programmes and projects that create lasting business impact across the organisation.

**Welcome to Strategy Execution and Transformation

**You'll be part of Strategy Execution and Transformation, where you'll join a team of experienced strategy, transformation, and consulting professionals responsible for supporting the development, deployment, and execution of Ørsted's strategy. The department is part of Strategy, Innovation and Transformation and works closely with colleagues across Group Strategy, Portfolio Management, Innovation, Finance, People & Culture, Communications.

As Head of Strategy Execution and Projects, you'll lead a team responsible for driving strategy deployment across Ørsted and delivering strategic initiatives that support our long-term ambitions. You'll also play an active role in the leadership team of Strategy Execution and Transformation, helping shape priorities, strengthen collaboration across teams, and foster an inclusive, high-performing culture aligned with Ørsted's leadership promises.

**You'll play an important role in:

**

• leading, developing, and empowering a high-performing team while building core capabilities and fostering a collaborative culture

• owning and continuously improving the annual strategy cycle, ensuring effective collaboration across Strategy, Finance, People & Culture, Communications, and the business areas

• ensuring that Ørsted's highest strategic priorities are translated into clear multi-year business plans, objectives, and execution roadmaps

• partnering with senior stakeholders across the organisation to identify, prioritise, and deliver strategic initiatives with measurable business impact

• providing strategic guidance on business cases, strategic assessments, implementation planning, and value realisation

• leading selected enterprise-critical projects and initiatives to secure successful outcomes and sustainable results.

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• have a strong track record of leading, developing, and motivating high-performing teams

• bring significant experience from strategy consulting, corporate strategy, transformation, or a similar strategic leadership environment

• demonstrate strong strategic thinking, problem-solving, and analytical capabilities, enabling you to translate complexity into clear recommendations and actions

• build trusted relationships and collaborate effectively with senior stakeholders across functions and business areas

• communicate clearly and confidently, adapting your message to different audiences and influencing decision-making at executive level

• hold a master’s degree within business, economics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Experience from the energy or renewable industry is beneficial but not required.

**Shape the future with us

**Send your application to us as soon as possible. We'll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to remove the advert when we've found the right candidate.

Maybe you've read the above and can see yourself in some of the criteria. Even if your experience doesn't match every requirement, we'd still like to hear from you. If you believe you can contribute to the role and our team, we encourage you to apply

Nordic Union for Employees in Hotel, Restaurant, Catering and Tourism (NU HRCT)

The Nordic Union for Employees in Hotel, Restaurant, Catering and Tourism (NU HRCT) is a federation of seven trade unions in Finland, Iceland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark. NU HRCT coordinates and strengthens cooperation across the Nordic HRCT sector.

NU HRCT represents 100,000 members at Nordic, European and global level. Our work is guided by the interests of employees in the Nordic hotel, restaurant, catering and tourism sectors and by a commitment to safeguarding the cornerstones of the Nordic model: the right to free collective bargaining and constructive cooperation with employers.

NU HRCT is now seeking a General Secretary who, together with the political leadership, will promote the interests of employees across the sector. The secretariat is in Denmark at the headquarters of the 3F union.

You can read more about NU HRCT on our website, including our purpose and responsibilities as set out in the statutes.

Main Responsibilities

The position includes, among other things:

• Proactively developing coordination and cooperation among member unions to make the Nordic HRCT sector a better place to work

• Developing and coordinating cooperation among NU HRCT member unions, together with the Executive Committee, to achieve the union’s objectives

• Preparing and convening Executive Committee meetings

• Ensuring that political decisions are implemented in practice and communicated clearly

• Planning and organizing Nordic conferences as well as meetings of working groups and ad hoc committees

• Representing the Nordic member unions, based on mandates and decisions of the Executive Committee, in European and international boards, committees and working groups within EFFAT, IUF and other relevant organizations

• Coordinating Executive Committee meetings and maintaining cooperation with the European and international trade union secretariats EFFAT and IUF

• Sharing responsibility with the Executive Committee for the union’s finances and accounting

• Coordinating and cooperating with the Nordic Union of Food Workers and the Nordic agriculture sector

• Preparing solidarity statements, newsletters, and press releases

• Maintaining the union’s website.

Required Qualifications and Competencies

Applicants are expected to have:

• Knowledge of the Nordic and European trade union movements

• Knowledge of the structure of NU HRCT and its member unions

• Experience with, and understanding of, the political and organizational structures of the Nordic labour market, including experience from trade union and/or political work

• Knowledge of the HRCT sector at both Nordic and global levels

• Strong cooperation and communication skills

• Experience in management and financial administration

• Knowledge of the European Union and the institutions related to labour market affairs

• Familiarity with the usual IT and AI tools

• The ability to speak and understand Scandinavian language, preferably also Icelandic and Finnish, and to communicate effectively in English.

Terms of Employment

• Employment terms, including salary and general working conditions, will be agreed with the recruitment committee of the Executive Committee

• The position is not subject to fixed working hours, and significant travel activity should be expected

• The secretariat, thus in principle the working place of the General Secretary, is located at Kampmannsgade 4, 1790 Copenhagen, Denmark. However, other working arrangements may be considered.

PAM in Finland currently holds the presidency of NU HRCT. For further information, please contact Annika Rönni-Sällinen by phone at +358 50 378 0270 or General Secretary Jens Petter Hagen by phone at +47 91 11 60 96.

Applicants are also welcome to contact any other member of the Executive Committee:

• 3F / Lone Soegaard Nielsen, lone.soegaard.nielsen@3f.dk, +45 2230 2931

• HRF / Daniel Jernström, Daniel.Jernstrom@hrf.net, +46 7016 66002

• SGS / Björg Bjarnadóttir, bjorg@sgs.is, +354 535 5672

• Matvís / Óskar Gunnarsson oskar@matvis.is, +354 580 5207

The position will be advertised through the seven Nordic member unions. Applications, including relevant supporting information, should be sent to jeanne.tingleff@3f.dk. Applications must be received by the secretariat no later than the 25th of October  2026.

Interviews are expected to take place during week 47. The successful candidate should take up the position no later than 1 May 2027. A flexible start date may be agreed if required by the candidate’s current employment circumstances.

• Are you passionate about regulatory processes and ensuring they work effectively across the product lifecycle?

Do you thrive in a structured, project-driven environment where your attention to detail and ability to create overview makes a real impact?

If you enjoy connecting the dots between processes, systems, documentation, and people, and occasionally asking "does this actually make sense?", you might fit right in.

We are looking for a Global Process Lead – Regulatory Affairs to join our Global Regulatory Affairs organization at our headquarters in Ballerup, Denmark.

You will become part of a collaborative and highly engaged team, working closely with stakeholders across functions and geographies. As Process Owner, you will help shape and develop regulatory processes across the product lifecycle and have real influence on how we work globally.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Ensure that the regulatory process remains effective, connected, and fit for purpose throughout the transition to a new lifecycle management system, while identifying opportunities for improvement

• A relevant academic degree in Life Sciences, Engineering, or similar, along with experience working within Regulatory Affairs in a regulated industry such as medical devices or pharma

**Deliver with focus. Scale with intent 🚀

**Are you a delivery leader who knows how to guide enterprise customers through complex set-ups without over-engineering the journey? Do you care deeply about building scalable, repeatable SaaS delivery rather than one-off custom projects?

At Performativ, we’re building the infrastructure layer for modern wealth management. As our Engagement Manager, you’ll lead the enterprise rollout of our SaaS platform helping customers onboard successfully through structured delivery, clear communication, and lightweight technical engagement.

This is not a professional services consulting role. You won’t be buried in endless customer-specific code or heavy customizations. Instead, you’ll work cross-functionally to help customers adopt our product the right way: cleanly, securely, and in line with platform best practices so they can scale on top of us, not around us.

**What You Will Do

**

• Own enterprise set-up programs end to end (kick-off through go-live and hyper-care) against an agreed plan and scope (Statement of Work).

• Enable customers to integrate Performativ via standard platform patterns (APIs, SSO, configuration) without custom buildouts, working with product and engineering to flag gaps early and advocate for scalable paths.

• Own plan, scope, and change control, keeping scope tied to contract and change visible and decided rather than quietly absorbed, and support the Technical Program Lead on requirements, design documents, and acceptance-criteria sign-off.

• Run customer communication, cadence, and governance with reporting that keeps meetings short, and manage risk, dependency, and issue tracking (including customer-side).

• Lead a clean handover to Customer Success at go-live or hyper-care exit, including train-the-trainer sessions and supporting materials.

• Represent the program in internal capacity and exception reviews, bringing requests the plan cannot absorb back as options rather than committing on the spot.

• Build repeatable playbooks, documentation, and artefacts that make the next program faster. You will be measured on this, not only on your own delivery.

**How You Will Work

**You will run multiple programs at once, in a delivery pod alongside the Technical Program Lead, Integration Engineers, Data Migration Specialists, and Product Engineers. None report to you. Rather you get things done through clarity and relationships, not authority. You will report to the COO. This is an in-office role based at our Copenhagen office.

**What We're Looking For

**

• 7+ years in program or engagement management, consulting, product management, or another delivery-facing role, with a track record of leading complex, multi-stakeholder implementations end to end.

• Comfort being firm with customers on scope and timeline while keeping the relationship stronger for it.

• Any industry background welcome. Experience with enterprise customers (banks, asset managers, regulated industries), balancing urgency against long-term maintainability highly advantageous.

• Structured and highly organized, producing written plans, governance cadences, and reporting that stakeholders can act on.

• Broad technical literacy across enterprise SaaS delivery: API-based integrations, SSO and security configuration, and data migration and mapping, including enough SQL to read and question a mapping. You do not build the integration, but you understand it well enough to scope it, question it, and know when something does not add up.

• Ability to build working fluency in the customer's business domain fast: within 90 days, able to discuss topics such as advice and suitability workflows and customer reporting without a subject-matter expert in the room.

• ITIL Foundation, PMP or PRINCE2 Certification would be beneficial.

**Technical Fluency

**

• You’re not, necessarily, a developer, but you’re comfortable with APIs, data structures, auth flows (OAuth/SAML), and deployment models.

• You can dive into logs, payloads, and basic SQL or Python when needed to unblock yourself or a customer - but you prioritize scalable fixes over tactical workarounds.

• You advocate for platform-aligned solutions, not special cases.

**What This Role Is Not

**This role sits in operations, not engineering or commercial, and is project-based: once delivery is complete, you roll on to the next engagement. As a SaaS provider, we do not build bespoke software; delivery works within the bounds of the product.

**We can offer :

**

• Trust and responsibility to shape how Performativ delivers for its largest customers.

• A competitive salary and benefits package.

• A fast-growing, VC-backed fintech scaleup, working alongside professionals from leading institutions (Goldman Sachs, McKinsey, BCG, Amazon and others).

• Career acceleration through professional development and leadership opportunities.

Private markets are being transformed — and you could be at the center of it.

**The gap between institutional grade private market tools and the technology that powers them has never been bigger. Trillions of dollars flow through private equity, venture capital, private credit, and real assets, yet the software managing this capital often lags a decade behind. SimCorp is changing that.

We're a fast-growing fintech company on a mission to modernize the private market ecosystem for institutional investors with cross-asset portfolios. We're scaling fast, our customers are the best in the world, and we're looking for a world-class Product Manager to help us build what comes next.

**If you understand the nuances of Private Markets, have a deep empathy for the professionals navigating this space, and know how to turn complexity into elegant software, we need to talk.

****WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**As a key component of product management for Private Markets, you will own the product strategy and execution alongside our engineering team. You will sit at the intersection of finance and technology translating the intricate workflows of private market professionals into intuitive, powerful software that delights users and drives business outcomes.

This is a high-visibility, high-impact role. You'll work directly with the leadership, clients, market participants, engineering, sales and go-to-market teams, and you'll have real ownership over a product area that is central to our company's growth. You will shape the roadmap, define priorities, and rally a talented team of engineers and designers around a shared vision.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Orchestrate high-stakes product demonstrations, executive roundtables, and client conferences to evangelize the solution and secure stakeholder buy-in across diverse audiences.

• Define, own and evolve the product roadmap for our private markets platform, balancing short-term customer needs with long-term strategic vision.

• Be the primary point of contact, the go-to person for private markets and collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders.

• Strategically own, manage and prioritize the product backlog in lockstep with Leadership, balancing technical debt with high-value strategic investments to ensure seamless delivery.

• Deeply immerse yourself in the workflows of private markets - conducting interviews, shadowing users, and synthesizing feedback into actionable insights.

• Write crisp, well-reasoned product specifications and work hand-in-hand with engineering and design to ship high-quality features on time.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to author comprehensive user features and stories, establishing rigorous acceptance criteria to ensure all deliverables meet 'Definition of Ready' and 'Definition of Done' standards in the acceptance of deliverables.

• Define success metrics for every initiative and use data to evaluate outcomes, iterate quickly, and communicate results to stakeholders.

• Partner with Sales and Customer Success to understand market gaps, competitive dynamics, and the evolving needs of our customer base.

• Identify and evaluate opportunities to integrate AI and automation into core workflows — making complex workflows faster, smarter, and more reliable.

• Drive alignment across cross-functional teams, ensuring clarity on priorities, tradeoffs, and the 'why' behind every decision.

• Stay ahead of regulatory developments, market trends, and competitive shifts in the private markets technology landscape.

• Represent the voice of the customer in every product decision — advocating relentlessly for user experience without sacrificing business viability.

**Who You Are

**You're not just a product manager, you're a private market expert who happens to love building software. You've spent time in or around private markets and you feel the pain points firsthand. You're the kind of person who gets genuinely excited when you see a workflow for the first time and immediately start mentally redesigning it. You are rigorous in your thinking, persuasive in your communication, and relentless in your follow-through.

You thrive in ambiguity. You can take a messy problem, break it down into its component parts, and build consensus around a path forward without needing every answer handed to you. You care about craft: a half-built feature or a confusing UX genuinely bothers you. And you're a collaborator at heart, you know that great products are built by great teams, and you know how to bring out the best in the people around you.

**What We Value

**

• 5+ years product management experience, with at least 2 years in B2B SaaS or fintech.

• Meaningful exposure to private markets, whether through prior work at a PE firm, fund administrator, placement agent, LP, or financial software company serving these markets.

• Demonstrated track record of successfully launching products and features that users love and that drive measurable business results.

• Strong understanding of private asset structures, capital calls, distributions, investor reporting, and related workflows.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills — you can write a tight one-pager and present to a room of skeptical executives with equal confidence and are not afraid to use AI.

• Proficiency in working with data: you're comfortable analyzing usage metrics and building dashboards to support your decisions.

• Experience collaborating with engineering teams in an agile environment; familiarity with modern development practices is a plus.

• High EQ and the ability to build trust quickly with customers, engineers, and senior leadership alike.

• A genuine curiosity about technology and its role in reshaping financial services.

• Experience engaging proactively with clients and stakeholders to solicit input for user stories.

• Broad knowledge of the Alternative Investment marketplace and system vendors.

• Experience with SimCorp Dimension® (advantageous but not required).

• Proven track record in roles such as Product Manager, Product Owner, Engineering, Business Analyst, Project Manager, or Consultant within software development.

• Strategic mindset with strong analytical skills focused on business outcomes and complete product offers.

• Ability to encourage, motivate, and influence teams and peers; contribute to improvements across the community.

• Understanding of how great products are built and deliver value to clients.

• Creative and inquisitive mindset with the ability to simplify complex concepts.

• Degree in Computer Science, Economics, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Finance, or a related field (preferred).

**Why Join Us

**

• Meaningful ownership — your decisions will shape a platform used by some of the world’s most sophisticated investors, and your work will have visible, lasting impact.

• A culture built on trust, autonomy, and deep collaboration.

• A leadership team with deep domain expertise, proven execution experience, and a genuine commitment to building an exceptional, humancentered culture.

• The opportunity to build category defining technology in a space undergoing massive transformation where your influence won’t just move the product forward, it will help reshape an entire industry.

• A place where craft matters, ideas win on merit, and people are encouraged to think boldly, act decisively, and do the best work of their careers.

**NEXT STEPS

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

For any questions you are welcome to contact Azeta GUITI Talent Acquisition Partner. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

**Who We Are

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experience, ages, and backgrounds in general.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated in our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients. While striving to deliver client value, we believe it is vital to consider our people and our planet in every business decision we make. Acting responsibly is not just optional, it is essential.

Scientific Software Engineer for Research Software Engineering Group

The European Spallation Source (ESS) is one of Europe’s largest research infrastructure projects and is building the world’s most powerful neutron source. Through cutting-edge science and technology, ESS will enable discoveries that advance our understanding of materials, energy, health, and the environment.

About the role

The Research Software Engineering (RSE) group develops and maintains critical software systems that make neutron scattering experiments at ESS possible and successful.

As a Scientific Software Engineer, you will contribute to the development of key platforms supporting the scientific user journey, including the ESS User Portal, metadata catalogue, electronic notebook, and related scientific information systems. You will work closely with scientists, software engineers, and stakeholders across ESS to gather requirements, understand user needs, and develop robust software solutions that integrate seamlessly with the wider ESS ecosystem.

The RSE group uses modern web technologies and software engineering practices to deliver high-quality software with a long operational lifetime. In addition, the group is expanding its focus on Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning solutions that can enhance the scientific user experience. As part of this effort, you will contribute to new AI-related initiatives and help establish RSE as a centre of expertise and development for AI applications within the Science Directorate.

This position is well suited for an experienced software engineer with a strong technical foundation, excellent collaboration skills, and a passion for building software that enables world-class scientific research.

Key responsibilities

• Design, develop, test, and maintain software systems supporting the scientific user journey at ESS.

• Contribute to the development of the ESS User Portal, metadata catalogue, electronic notebook, and related scientific information management systems.

• Gather, analyse, and refine requirements from scientific and technical stakeholders across ESS.

• Design and implement integrations between RSE applications and other ESS services and platforms.

• Apply modern software engineering practices to deliver reliable, maintainable, and high-quality software solutions.

• Contribute to technical and process improvements within the SIMS group.

• Participate in AI and Machine Learning initiatives supporting the Science Directorate.

• Collaborate with scientists, software engineers, and international partners to develop innovative solutions for scientific computing and data management.

• Provide technical guidance and knowledge sharing within the team when appropriate.

• Contribute to software architecture discussions and technology decisions within the group.

Required qualifications

• Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Physics, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

• Typically 4-7 years of relevant professional experience in software development.

• Experience developing modern web applications and services.

• Strong programming skills and experience with modern software development practices.

• Experience gathering requirements and working directly with stakeholders and end users.

• Experience designing and implementing integrations between complex software systems.

• Ability to work independently and manage technical tasks and projects with limited supervision.

• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

Desirable qualifications

• Experience working with scientific software, research infrastructures, or data-intensive environments.

• Experience with cloud-based services and distributed systems.

• Experience with Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning technologies and their practical application.

• Experience with user-facing platforms, portals, or information management systems.

• Familiarity with modern DevOps practices, CI/CD, automated testing, and container technologies.

• Experience working in international and multidisciplinary environments.

• Experience contributing to open-source software projects.

What we offer

DMSC is located on the DTU campus in Kongens Lyngby, north of Copenhagen, while the ESS neutron facility is based in Lund, Sweden. Together, they form a unique cross-border scientific environment in the Øresund region.

You will join a dynamic and highly collaborative international workplace with colleagues representing nearly 60 nationalities across ESS and DMSC. We offer flexible working conditions, opportunities for professional development, and close interaction between computational science, instrumentation, and large-scale experiments.

Benefits include 25 + 5 annual leave days in addition to public and company holidays, an attractive pension scheme, preventative healthcare benefits, and relocation support for international hires where applicable.

This is a full-time, permanent position based in Kongens Lyngby, Denmark, and we need someone who can start as soon as practically possible.

Learn more about living and working in Scandinavia: https://ess.eu/living-working-scandinavia

For further information

For information about the position, contact the Group Leader for SIMS, Fredrik Bolmsten at Fredrik.bolmsten@ess.eu.

For recruitment-related questions, contact Recruitment Officer Janne Erwolter at janne.erwolter@ess.eu.

Application deadline

Please submit your application no later than November 5, 2026.

About the position

Join MicroTech Software to build cutting-edge AI-powered tools for insurance professionals. Work on production RAG chatbots, agentic workflows, and voice-to-workflow capabilities.

At MicroTech Software we build cutting edge AI-powered tools that help insurance professionals answer complex questions faster and with greater confidence. Our flagship product is a production RAG chatbot used daily by insurance workers, and we are actively pushing its architecture in several new directions at once using the newest models. Your reference will be our AI Lead. We are looking for an engineer with 2–4 years of experience who has reached the point where writing good code is no longer the hard part — and who is ready to take on the harder questions: which approach to use, how to structure a system for long-term maintainability, and where to invest engineering time to get the most impact. You will work in a team with a very advanced team lead whom you can expect to learn from and alongside one or more junior engineers and be expected to help set the direction of their work as well as your own.

Responsibilities

• Shape the architecture of a live AI product

• Evaluate and challenge design decisions across the stack — retrieval strategies, LLM backend selection, service boundaries, data flow — and propose improvements with clear reasoning

• Participate in technical planning with the team and with insurance-domain stakeholders, translating vague requirements into concrete engineering tasks

• Identify technical debt, assess its cost, and make the case for addressing it

• Navigate an on-prem transition

• Design and lead the migration of a cloud-dependent LLM stack to a fully local alternative: self-hosted models, local embedding, and on-prem vector stores

• Evaluate open-weight LLMs for Danish-language RAG quality; understand the trade-offs in latency, accuracy, and hardware requirements

• Contribute to a RAG → GraphRAG transition: build a knowledge graph and integrate it into an existing RAG pipeline

• Design and build agentic workflows

• Design multi-step agent architectures using LangGraph or equivalent frameworks that can route, plan, use tools, and synthesize across document corpora

• Define tool-use interfaces, memory patterns, and failure handling strategies for agent loops running in production

• Work with domain experts to identify automation opportunities worth building

• Enable voice-to-workflow capabilities

• Contribute to the design of a pipeline that integrates local speech-to-text models into agentic workflows

• Evaluate Danish-language ASR quality, identify gaps, and assess the feasibility of fine-tuning or model selection approaches

• Design the integration points carefully — latency, error handling, data privacy — so voice becomes a first-class input channel

We are looking for someone who can say yes to

Must-have

• 2–4 years of production Python engineering experience, including async code, clean architecture patterns, and testable codebases

• Direct experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain or similar) in a shipped product or serious project

• Solid understanding of RAG systems: chunking strategies, embedding models, vector search, retrieval quality evaluation

• Familiarity with vector databases — pgvector, Chroma, Weaviate, Pinecone, or equivalent

• Comfortable owning a FastAPI service end-to-end: schema design, error handling, auth, containerization, deployment

• Ability to reason about architectural trade-offs and communicate them clearly

Strong advantages

• Hands-on experience designing or running local LLM inference — Ollama, vLLM, llama.cpp — in a real rather than toy context

• Familiarity with knowledge graphs — ontology building, knowledge extraction, RAG integration

• Experience with agentic frameworks: LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or custom tool-use / planning loops in production

• Speech-to-text pipeline work — Whisper, Deepgram, Speechmatics, or comparable local STT — especially on non-English languages

• Experience designing hybrid retrieval systems (dense + sparse, BM25 + vector) and re-ranking with cross-encoders

• Familiarity with LLM observability and tracing tools (Arize Phoenix, LangSmith, or similar)

• Exposure to multilingual NLP, particularly Danish or other Nordic languages

Nice to have

• Knowledge of regulated-industry data handling, GDPR, or EU AI Act compliance considerations

• Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure preferred): managed services, container registries, CI/CD

jobs.occupation: Senior Regional Manager Italy, Arla Foods - Copenhagen
jobs.description:
**Are you ready to lead our commercial agenda and unlock the next wave of growth for Arla in Italy?

**This is an opportunity to take full ownership of a strategically important market and develop Arla’s Italian business through our distributor partnership with Eurofood. You will combine strategic direction with hands-on commercial leadership, accelerating profitable growth across Lurpak®, Starbucks® and, over time, other categories in Arla’s portfolio. Italy also represents a significant private-label business, which will be an important part of your responsibilities.

Based at our office in Carlsberg Byen, Copenhagen, you will join Arla’s ROW Distributor Sales organisation and report directly to the Cluster Head of Europe. The Italian market is operated through our distributor setup with Eurofood, making close cooperation, clear priorities and strong partner leadership essential to success.

**How You Will Make An Impact

**You will be responsible for driving profitable and sustainable growth in Italy, with full ownership of the commercial agenda and P&L. Together with Eurofood, you will shape the long-term business strategy, translate it into ambitious annual plans and ensure that joint priorities create measurable impact in the market.

Your key responsibilities will be to

• Own and develop the Italian business with full P&L accountability, balancing profitable growth with long-term market development.

• Shape the long-term strategy and annual business plans together with Eurofood, establishing clear commercial priorities and performance expectations.

• Lead commercial negotiations and develop competitive pricing, volume and forecasting plans across branded and private-label business.

• Accelerate the growth and execution of Lurpak®, Starbucks® and other relevant categories by ensuring strong brand, category and in-market performance.

• Collaborate closely with Eurofood and internal partners across Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain and Product Management to turn plans into effective execution.

The position offers a high degree of autonomy and broad exposure across the European business. It includes approximately 20 to 30 travel days per year.

**What Will Make You Successful

**You are a commercially driven sales leader with sound judgement and the ability to create results through external partners. You have a higher education in Business, Commerce or a related field and at least five years of experience in international FMCG sales. Experience managing distributor-led markets is important, and you are comfortable taking full responsibility for a P&L and making commercially sound decisions based on financial and market insights.

You combine strategic thinking with hands-on follow-up and can translate ambitious growth objectives into focused plans and consistent execution. Strong financial understanding and solid IT skills enable you to work confidently with forecasts, pricing, volumes and performance development. You communicate fluently in English and Italian and work effectively across functions, organisations and cultures.

Personally, you bring ownership, collaborative leadership and resilience. You establish clear direction while building trusted relationships, and you remain focused and adaptable when priorities or market conditions change. Your ability to influence stakeholders and bring people together around a shared commercial agenda will be central to your success.

**What do we offer?

jobs.occupation: Department Manager for Automated Solutions at Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
If you’re energised by automated logistics and its integration and you thrive on participating in and driving engineering design, we’d love to hear from you!

**Who We Are

**We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

**About The Role

**We are looking for a Department Manager to join our Automated Solutions department. In this role, you will spend approximately half of your time working on projects and the other half managing the day-to-day operations and long-term development of the department. As a team, we work with physical design and system integration to support the successful implementation of automated logistics solutions for API manufacturing, in close collaboration with vendors and customers.

Your project experience will provide valuable insights for developing the department, while your management responsibilities will include resource management, employee development and exploring future business opportunities. Your contribution will be key to the team’s continued success as demand for automated solutions grows within pharma engineering.

Location Virum or Kalundborg

Experience Minimum 3 Years

Department Automated Solutions

**How You Might Spend Your Days

**As a Department Manager, you’ll be:

• Working on projects alongside your team

• Managing resources across projects

• Supporting employee growth and development

• Driving technical and discipline development together with senior specialists

• Contributing to a cross-disciplinary management team consisting of managers and senior specialists

**Who You Are

**We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• A good listener with a solution-oriented mindset

• Agile and able to prioritise urgent tasks

• Understanding of your colleagues’ individual and cultural differences

• Attentive to your surroundings and comfortable raising concerns

• A collaborative team player

**What You Bring To The Role

**In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• You have at least 3 years of management experience

• You have a BSc/MSc in mechatronics engineering, electrical engineering, transport and logistics with a focus on automation, or a similar field

• You have a minimum of 3 years of experience working with automated solutions

• You are fluent in written and spoken English

**Life at NNE

**NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer **here .

****Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

****Deadline of application is 31st October 2026

**Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Contact Director Deenesh Kavi Babi at +45 3077 4611.

**Please note:

**

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

**Fair hiring:

**At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

**Still searching for the right opportunity?

**If this position isn’t quite what you're looking for, but you know someone who would excel in this role, please share this job post. And don’t forget to explore our other exciting opportunities — your future role at NNE might be just around the corner! Visit our Career Site

jobs.occupation: Senior Full-Stack Developer – Modern Engineering & Agentic Coding
jobs.description:
Senior Full-Stack Developer – Modern Engineering & Agentic Coding

If you care about doing full-stack development the right way – through clean architecture, automation, CI/CD, IaC, observability, golden paths, and engineering foundations – you’ll feel right at home at the Tech Collective, where we combine deep technical skills with real client impact.

What you’ll do

Life as a consultant is different from a typical in-house role. At the Tech Collective, consulting means working on a wide range of projects with various clients – so you'll regularly encounter new challenges and have plenty of opportunities to grow your skills quickly.

We believe AI and agentic coding accelerate great developer practices – they do not replace them. That’s why solid architecture, quality, security, maintainability, and sound technical judgement matter more than ever.

In this senior role, you’ll help us understand client needs and turn them into real outcomes by taking technical ownership, guiding teams, and delivering robust solutions from idea to production.

• 
Build, test, and deliver software using modern engineering practices such as everything-as-code, CI/CD, GitOps, automation, and open-source principles

• 
Act as a trusted advisor to clients, helping them make great decisions and turn ideas into practical solutions

• 
Work across frontend and backend technologies, taking part in architectural decisions, system design, containerised environments, and clear, maintainable documentation

• 
Improve developer and user experience by shifting quality left, applying strong design principles, mentoring others, and delivering minimum viable products with a clear path to scale

• 
Design, build, and operate platforms and infrastructure, including APIs, CLIs, platform engineering, immutable infrastructure, and internal developer platforms

• 
Collaborate, teach, and lead through effective communication, technical writing, code reviews, lean principles, and strong data and security practices

• 
Lead technical workstreams and collaborate closely with clients, translating business needs into pragmatic technical solutions

What you’ll bring

One thing that can be said of all your future colleagues is that we’re curious by nature, have a team-first mindset, a good sense of humour, and clear opinions on how tech can create value for our clients. If this sounds like you, you’ll be a great fit at The Tech Collective.

We’re looking for people with a relevant M.Sc. (this is mandatory and could be, for example, in computer science or software engineering) who are based within commuting distance of our office in Copenhagen.

We’re looking for someone with a minimum of 5 years of professional experience in full-stack software development or similar engineering roles.

On top of that, the ideal candidate is someone who brings senior engineering experience and:

• 
Communicates clearly in both written and spoken English

• 
Shares our values around software quality and delivery

• 
Enjoys working closely with clients and building trusted relationships with them

• 
Is tool-agnostic and chooses the right tool for the job

• 
Is comfortable with complexity and able to break problems down into manageable pieces

• 
Has solid experience building and operating modern software systems in production

• 
Understands software architecture, system design, testing, security, and maintainability

• 
Can guide technical decisions, challenge assumptions, and communicate trade-offs clearly

• 
Has experience mentoring or supporting other developers through code reviews, pairing, or technical sparring

Please note that you don’t need to meet all the criteria. The most important thing is that you have an engineering foundation, a senior mindset, consulting skills and curiosity to keep learning and growing.

What we offer

When you step into our office, you step into a world of nerdery – and we love it and intend to keep it that way. You’ll become part of a low-ego, high-trust team of sharp engineers who you’ll work closely with from day one.

Working with us means:

• 
Real autonomy, real impact: you’ll own features end to end and lean into the tech you care most about.

• 
Growth that matters: a learning programme, mentoring, and plenty of peer knowledge sharing.

• 
Community and craft: strategy trips, meetups, and events across The Tech Collective/Implement Consulting Group.

Ready to shape the digital future with us? Let us know why and how in your cover letter and apply ASAP.

We’re on holiday during July, so please expect slightly longer response times.

_Are you an experienced leader with a strong track record in offshore wind operations, service delivery, or project execution? Do you thrive in dynamic environments where safety, customer focus, and operational excellence go hand in hand? Then we look forward to your application as Area Manager (f/m/d) for Main Component Exchanges!

_**Your position

**In your new position as Area Manager (f/m/d) for the Main Component Exchanges, you will lead the regional delivery of our offshore MCE business across Northern & Central Europe or the UK. You will be accountable for regional performance and play a key role in ensuring the successful execution of complex offshore campaigns. The position is based on the responsibilities defined in the MCE operating model.

The position is full-time, and you can expect to travel regularly depending on your main place of work. The projects are typically short- and long-term service contracts for our clients in Northern and Central Europe as well as the UK.

**Your Tasks & Responsibilities

**As Area Manager (f/m/d), you will be responsible for the overall performance of your region and ensure that customer commitments are delivered safely, efficiently, and predictably. You will provide leadership across Project Management, Operational Management, and Marine Operations while maintaining strong relationships with customers and key stakeholders. The role combines strategic oversight with operational leadership and serves as the primary escalation point within the region.

**Your Tasks Will Include But Are Not Limited To

**

• Leading regional project and operational delivery performance

• Ensuring successful delivery of customer commitments regarding safety, quality, schedule, and cost

• Prioritizing resources and resolving cross-project conflicts

• Managing customer, operational, and project escalations

• Supporting strategic workload and capability planning

• Driving collaboration across Project Management, Operational Management, and Marine Operations

• Ensuring implementation of the MCE operating model across the region

• Supporting Sales & Business Development through customer, market and operational expertise

**Your Profile & Qualifications

**We are looking for an experienced and communicative Area Manager (f/m/d) who is passionate about Main Component Exchanges within Offshore Wind and wants to take ownership. You have a proactive and organised approach to your work.

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you have:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Business, Project Management, or a related discipline

• Proven leadership experience in offshore wind, marine operations, energy services, or a comparable industry

• Strong understanding of project delivery, operations, and customer management

• Experience managing multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders

• Excellent communication and decision-making skills

• A strong HSEQ mindset and commitment to safe execution

• Fluency in English, both written and spoken

**Welcome to Semco Maritime

**At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.

Care to join the movement?

Change. With us.

Join us in this role where you’ll provide people and technical leadership to the Continental Europe Reliability Engineering team. You’ll set priorities, develop capabilities, and enable consistent, high-quality reliability support across our wind farms. Through data-driven decisions and close collaboration, you’ll help address technical risks, improve asset performance, and strengthen the way we work across sites and turbine platforms.

**Welcome to Generation CE

**You’ll be part of WTG Engineering where you, together with your colleagues, will support our operational sites by identifying and addressing technical risks, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, and improvement opportunities. You’ll connect Reliability Engineers, site teams, CE Engineering, Technical Support, and other specialist functions to coordinate effective corrective and preventive actions.

As a team, we share knowledge, support one another, and turn technical insight into practical improvements. We succeed as one by building trust across sites, giving our experts the context and space to make decisions, and keeping safety at the heart of our work.

**You’ll play an important role in:

**

• leading, motivating, and developing an international team of Reliability Engineers through clear objectives, coaching, competence planning, and development conversations

• translating Generation, CE Engineering, and site priorities into an aligned reliability engineering plan with clear ownership, milestones, and outcomes

• ensuring structured analysis of reliability performance, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, technical risks, and emerging trends

• overseeing root-cause analyses, technical assessments, corrective and preventive actions, and prioritised reliability improvement initiatives

• strengthening consistent reliability practices, knowledge sharing, and collaboration across operational sites, engineering functions, suppliers, and technical support teams

• promoting a proactive safety culture and ensuring compliance with asset integrity, HSE, governance, and applicable technical requirements.

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• have a relevant technical or engineering qualification within mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, reliability, asset management, wind energy, or a comparable field, or equivalent experience

• bring leadership experience that enables you to develop people, set priorities, allocate resources, and create clarity across an international or multi-site team

• understand wind turbine operations, reliability engineering, technical support, maintenance engineering, asset integrity, or another high-reliability industry

• have strong knowledge of reliability and continuous-improvement methods, such as root-cause analysis, trend analysis, failure-mode analysis, reliability-centred maintenance, risk assessment, and corrective-action management

• can interpret technical and operational performance data and turn your findings into clear priorities, decisions, and measurable improvement actions

• communicate complex technical matters clearly, build trusted stakeholder relationships, and work professionally in English.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

**Shape the future with us

**Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

**Position salary range:

**For this role, the base pay will be determined according to the relevant pay structure for the location where the position is filled. Actual pay will be based on skills, experience, and the expected role fulfilment to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package. Pay details specific to your location will be provided during the interview process.

**Pre-employment background checks:

**For certain positions, a background check may be required as part of the hiring process. Because we recruit across multiple countries, the specific checks performed will depend on the role and the legal requirements in the location where the position is filled. If a background check is relevant for the role you are being considered for, you will be informed during the recruitment process. All background checks are carried out by an external provider and always in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.
